name: Nerra Voices
tagline: Real people. Real work. AI host.
description: Nerra Voices is the Nerra Network's catch-all interview show: an AI host, real human guests from every field, live recorded conversations about their work, and disclosure built into every episode.

episodes.title: Ep1: Viktor Popovic — An immigrant founder who rebuilt after losing Google traffic overnight now routes merchant payments in real time to expose the hidden fees his first company’s margins never revealed.
episodes.summary: Viktor Popovic rebuilt after 21 years running Ultimate Washer by creating Avendo, a platform that routes each merchant transaction in real time across multiple processors so the lowest price wins without any lock-in.
